name: Harry Schell
features: dark hair, round cheerful face, heavy build, permanent half-smile, cigarette never far away
bio: American by passport, Parisian by upbringing, and the most gregarious man in the paddock. Son of the Ecurie Bleue owners, he raced everything from Maseratis to BRMs across a decade and started more Grands Prix than any other American of his time. Killed in practice for a minor race at Silverstone in 1960, in the wet.
